label: Mental Health
assignment: Discover realistic mental-health resources for people in {service_area}, from crisis response and urgent assessment through counseling, psychiatry, medication, peer support, and continuing care. Follow health systems and referral lines to specific programs while verifying clinical scope, age, payment, current appointments, crisis hours, language, accessibility, and the real intake path.
include: Crisis lines, mobile crisis, receiving centers, urgent assessment, and suicide-safety support
Counseling, psychiatry, medication management, groups, peer support, and case management
Community mental-health, Medicaid, uninsured, sliding-scale, school, and telehealth pathways
Services for children, families, trauma survivors, severe mental illness, perinatal needs, reentry, and co-occurring conditions
Hospital discharge, ongoing-care transitions, transportation, language, and disability access
exclude: Emergency services presented as routine continuing care without a follow-up pathway
Provider directories without verified availability, payer acceptance, or intake
Unlicensed wellness services presented as substitutes for needed clinical treatment
